Here's a summary of the key information I have about the National University of Río Cuarto:

- The National University of Río Cuarto (Universidad Nacional de Río Cuarto or UNRC) is a public university located in Río Cuarto, Córdoba Province, Argentina.

- It was founded in 1971 and is one of the national universities operated by the Argentine Ministry of Education.

- The university offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs across a range of academic disciplines including the sciences, humanities, social sciences, and technical fields.

- Some of the main academic units and schools within the university include the School of Agronomy and Veterinary Sciences, School of Exact, Physical and Natural Sciences, School of Economics, and School of Humanities.

- The university has around 12,000 students enrolled across its programs. It is considered one of the major higher education institutions in the Córdoba region of central Argentina.

- The UNRC campus is located on the outskirts of Río Cuarto city. The university also has some additional facilities and premises in the surrounding areas.

- In terms of research, the UNRC conducts work across various fields and collaborates with other academic and scientific institutions both in Argentina and internationally.

That covers the key facts I'm confident providing about the National University of Río Cuarto based on the information available to me. Let me know if you need any additional details.
